verdict.rationale: Groq is an API-first inference service, so it runs headlessly by design. It uses API-key authentication against a REST endpoint, works with drop-in OpenAI-compatible clients, ships an official server-side TypeScript SDK, and offers an asynchronous Batch API for large unattended workloads. Automated spend limits further support unattended use. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, an official CLI for scripted use, and independent hands-on reports of running it in CI pipelines.
